experimental_design: proteomic characterization of ExtraPEG-isolated extracellular vesicles from HeLa cells

The optimized ExtraPEG precipitation method (8% PEG + wash) was used to harvest extracellular vesicles, which were lysed, gel-purified, and in-gel digested. The resulting peptides were extracted and analyzed by liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry.
